name: drawer
useFor: Use on touch screens for a short task or a list to act on (steering running subagents) that should feel like part of the page. Put the title in DrawerHeader and stacked actions in DrawerFooter. direction="right" or "left" makes a swipeable side panel; on desktop prefer Dialog or Sheet.
constraints: Content that needs a long scroll
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: the square ground panel of its popups (.hn__sheet), the dock curve (--dock) and the long soft cast; built on Base UI's drawer for the swipe.
title: Drawer
description: A square sheet of the ground that rises from the bottom edge, ruled off by the quiet line with a long soft cast, over the ink at 32 percent: a small square handle near its top, a centered Chakra Petch light 20px title over a 14px graphite description, stacked hexagon keys. It slides its own height on the dock curve and follows a swipe down to close. A long body scrolls inside the panel and fades at the edge it scrolls past (fade-y).
